title: Integrated chitosan-based polyelectrolyte membranes and microwave-assisted advanced oxidation processes for sustainable coir retting wastewater treatment
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00807G, Paper
Greeshma Thankachan, Nisha K. Joseph, Manoj P. Rayaroth, Charuvila T. Aravindakumar, Usha K. Aravind
Coir retting effluent, rich in lignocellulosic and phenolic compounds, poses serious environmental challenges due to its high chemical oxygen demand (COD), conductivity, and salinity.
